intermediate.name: Passo di Santa Barbara
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Passo di Santa Barbara (76.8 km)

story: João Almeida won the stage after attacking from the favorites’ group in the final kilometres. Geraint Thomas was the only rider able to follow, and the pair distanced Primož Roglič. Almeida beat Thomas in the sprint, while Thomas reclaimed the pink jersey and Roglič lost important time.
